read_problems: Table has two tax/carrying-charge scenarios (assuming tax benefits vs no tax benefits); used "no tax benefits" columns G/G for tax_m/carry_m per instructions.
Appurtenant Square Footage (column B) used as ext_sf per Key (Cellar/Terrace/Balcony), though some units (C suffix) may be cellar storage rather than outdoor space.

beds/baths for units like 2T, 2U, 3A, etc. printed as combined code (e.g. "2/2/T", "1/1/B") including amenity letter rather than separate numeric beds/baths; transcribed as printed in beds column, baths left as "-".

tax_m column: two tax scenarios printed (with/without real estate tax benefits); used "Assuming Real Estate Tax Benefits" monthly figure (column F) to match carry_m column (Assuming Real Estate Tax Benefits).

carry_m: used "Projected Montly Carrying Charges Assuming Real Estate Tax Benefits" column; a second carrying charge column "Assuming No Real Estate Tax Benefits" also printed but not transcribed per instructions (only one carry_m cell allowed).

Beds/baths derived from combined "Bedrooms/Bathrooms-Amenities" code (e.g., "2/2/B") per instructions not to derive from room counts; used first two numbers as beds/baths as explicitly printed format. RT units have no beds/bath data printed (dash).
Unit "Number of Bedrooms/Bathrooms - Amenities" column (A) is blank/empty for all rows on this page; beds/baths not stated.

cc_m and tax_m columns chosen assuming no real estate tax benefits scenario (columns F "no tax benefits" and G carrying charges no tax benefits) based on best match with carry_m; the "assuming tax benefits" scenario figures were not used.

Table has two tax/carrying-charge scenarios (assuming real estate tax benefits vs. no benefits); used the "Assuming Real Estate Tax Benefits" columns (F and Projected Monthly Carrying Charges Assuming Real Estate Tax Benefits) for tax_m and carry_m as the first-listed scenario.

Table has two tax scenarios (with/without real estate tax benefits) and two carrying charge scenarios; used the "Assuming Real Estate Tax Benefits" pairing (tax_m=5.49, carry_m=66.06) per rule; the "No Real Estate Tax Benefits" scenario (tax 76.78, carry 921.40 annual/137.36 monthly) was not used.
Unit Square Footage (153) column header is generic "Unit Square Footage," not explicitly labeled interior/net; used as int_sf per instructions.
